summary: Propose a CPU/schema/fixture-only prospective nursery causal-trace contract: a hash-chained nine-event ledger, typed action boundary, role-root visibility enforcement, reversible dream-successor evidence, and provenance-bound sleep/adapter receipts. It authorizes no live life, task selection, lesson, model/tokenizer/trainer/evaluator/GPU execution, or scientific claim before exact human ratification and later gates.
system_thesis: The organism learns across recurrent lived action/outcome episodes, dream-time local connection growth and memory re-expression, and sleep-time parametric consolidation/transport. Goal-conditioned retrieval, composition, planning, and revision arise in the complete organism across these loops; a LoRA can carry admitted information across time but is not itself credited with discovery. This proposal minimally instruments that causal path prospectively, preserving THINK as free-flow generation, DREAM as context reconciliation, and SLEEP as selected transformation plus write.
title: Prospective nursery causal-trace contract v1
